label: Well-founded causal predecessors: The directed causal relation is well-founded in the…
definition: The directed causal relation is well-founded in the accessibility sense: every node has an inductively terminating inspection of predecessors. Finite cycles and endlessly descending predecessor chains are excluded, while arbitrarily deep finite paths remain possible.
note: Mathematical predicate, not an independently established premise about real causation or the past. The relation orientation is from cause to dependent.
